data.desc: No one knows noodles like Noodles. Since 1995, Noodles & Company has brought guests craveable, expertly prepared noodle dishes through a menu that blends classic comfort with bold, globally inspired flavors. From longtime favorites like Creamy Mac & Cheese and Japanese Pan Noodles to comforting bowls of ramen, Noodles draws on more than 30 years of noodle expertise to create dishes that deliver comfort, discovery, and connection in every bowl.
